sentences.text: This Writ Petition is filed seeking for a direction to respondent Nos.1 and 2 to consider the representation dated 08.07.2023 and dispose of the same.

2. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner was an accused in C.C.No.334 of 2013 before the learned District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate, Peraiyur, for the offences under Sections 120 (B), 420, 468 and 471 of I.P.C. and he filed Crl.O.P.(MD).No.210 of 2017, seeking quashment of the same and the said petition was allowed on 23.01.2017 quashing the case registered against him.

entities.text: District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate, Peraiyur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that subsequently, no case is registered against the petitioner and as of now, there is no criminal case on his head.
It is submitted that the petitioner has submitted an application before the Passport Authorities for renewal of the Passport.

When the Passport Authorities have sent for verification of antecedents of the petitioner, the respondent Police have sent a report stating that C.C.No.334 of 2013 was pending, thereby, the passport renewal could not be done by the Passport authorities, thereby, sought for a suitable direction.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.

Learned Government Advocate (Criminal Side) representing the respondents submitted that same C.C.No.334 of 2013 has already been quashed by this Court and respondent Police are prepared to give a fresh report to the Passport Department stating that there is no case pending against him.
The same is recorded.

4. Therefore, the petitioner is directed to file a fresh application before the Passport Authorities for renewal of the passport and once the Passport Authorities sent for the verification of the antecedents, the respondent Police are directed to give a report that C.C.No.334 of 2013 has already been quashed.
5. With the above direction, the Writ Petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
